notes.title: Spam meter and other interface improvements: Patch 1.222
notes.content:
Hello Puppy Photographers,

This update includes several improvements to the UI to help make objective and warnings much more clear. Here are the latest patch notes for version 1.222:

[b]UI[/b]
[olist]
[*] New "spam" meter shows how many photos can be posted to dognet before spamming
[*] There are now sound effects on the UI!
[*] Removed the confusing "complete" button on Journal screen
[*] Dialogue text is now animated to help with pacing/reading
[*] Better selection cursor art
[*] Mouse wheel can now be used to scroll through objectives on the Journal
[*] Spam emoji icon is now less angry
[*] Purchased items are no longer shown in the shop
[/olist]

[b]
Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Several inaccessible photo request missions have been fixed
[*] Look input smoothing is much less aggressive
[*] Mystery quest room in Mellowstone is no longer reset when leaving the level
[/list]

Also, this addresses what we feel are the largest outstanding issues on desktop. (We know there are still some big problems on console, which we should be patching soon!) Unless we discover any large new issues, this may be the final update. 

Thank you so much to everyone who's played and posted your beautiful pup photos! If you'd like to share them with us, we're retweeting all the ones we see from [url=https://twitter.com/playpupperazzi]https://twitter.com/playpupperazzi[/url] so tag us in if you want to make sure we don't miss it!

Bark bark!
Kitfox & Sundae Month

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.210
notes.content:
Hello Pupparazzos!

We have the second round of patch notes. Please continue to report any issues or bugs on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1028350/discussions/0/3186860850586553398/]Known Issues Thread.[/url]

[b]Changes[/b]

- Access to all levels/times of day are now available in the final tier of the shop. This will prevent players from getting stuck with no way to access certain areas


[b]Improvements[/b]

- Bonks are a little easier to get
- Made a few small fixes so photos should now register correctly more often
- An icon has been added to the journal to let you know when you have a request that can be turned in


[b]New Features/Content[/b]

- The boombox music has been replaced, it now matches the soundtrack (and it's a really great bop)


We are looking into more issues and will have further updates in the coming weeks

-Alexandra+ Sundae Month

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.125
notes.content:
Hello Pupparazzos!

Here is the first round of patch notes. Please continue to report any issues or bugs on our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1028350/discussions/0/3186860850586553398/] Known Issues Thread[/url]. 

Changes

-Saving photos is now integrated with the Steam screenshot system!
-Game is now playable on Mac M1 (various issues fixed including disappearing text and photos not appearing properly)
-"Recycle photos" screen should now always work with gamepads
-Several animation fixes (dogs rolling over, running away from scootvac)

Improvements

-Slight improvements to photo content detection
-Options menu slightly adjusted to reduce accidental language changes
-Particles no longer appear sideways in portrait photos

New Features/Content
-Minor art fixes to Boardwalk & Mellowstone (Froggurt vendors now wear lil' frog hats)
-A new mission is available on the post-credits level (it was supposed to be in at launch but it wasn't working)

To Xbox players: The patch is live now as well. Please check the [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]pupperazzi Discord channel[/url] for the latest updates.

-Alexandra+ Sundae Month

notes.title: Release Update + New toys
notes.content:
Hello Pupper Photographers! 

Unfortunately we have a little bit of an official-unofficial announcement that although we hoped to launch Pupperazzi in 2021, it's looking less and less likely.

We are currently targeting January, but since lots of AAA games still haven't announced their Q1 launch dates (and we don't want to launch the same day as a game with zillions of marketing, even if it's a different audience), we don't have a specific launch date to announce yet either.

When we DO have a specific date, we'll be sure to let you know with a fancy release date trailer ASAP.

The good news is that the build actually already passed certification for Xbox! but... the frame rate still wasn't good enough for us to feel good about launching. I guess we have high standards, but, there's just so many little issues and bugs! So we want to make sure to take as much time as we need to make it super polished and shiny..

[h2]Toys![/h2]

We've added a bunch of new toys that the dogs can play with. These are great for getting the attention of a whole pack of dogs or getting a unique photo of their reactions. The boombox is one of our favourites for an impromptu dog dance party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/aa342b1dd63a90f1069dc408645b366705e5719a.png[/img]

Thank you so much for your understanding and support as we continue working hard on the game.

-Alexandra + Sundae Month

notes.title: New Interface and Wholesome Games
notes.content:
Hello Pupper Photographers!


We are excited to announce that Pupperazzi will be featured during Wholesome Direct 2021 with a brand new level to show off! We can't say too much about it now but it's going to be the biggest one yet. Check out the full show on June 12th 10am PT / 1pm ET. You can find more information at [url=wholesomegames.com]wholesomegames.com[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/59889980f1671d63d33ec55eaa9cb239c04f085e.png[/img]

[h2]New Interface[/h2]

The team at Sundae month has been working hard on revamping the menus, your inventory and the mission screen.

The old system had more clicks, didn't have a photo preview, and was harder to understand. This is a picture of a very ancient placeholder menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/a0266784c2377d1a356c307e2d4e61fd459a9f4d.png[/img]

And here is the new mission menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/a6dd3f1cf249a97bcac0478254accca109b7a8c6.jpg[/img]

We also have our new edit camera menu, which allows you to preview what your lens and film will look like together. Watch the [url=https://youtu.be/KoQvsNFqHxg]full video[/url]:

[previewyoutube=KoQvsNFqHxg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/5d683b6d4d06599823262d0978aba2605f9e221a.png[/img]

You can now edit your camera on the fly without needing to leave the level. We hope that players will be able to experiment with different styles and colours before they take the final shot. Once you have your photo, you can submit to the DogNet to gain follows and comments on your work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/46dc6a0061abb3a5657477770a5e9e3dc00c046e.jpg[/img]

We have more menu updates to show soon and stay tuned for the new reveal at Wholesome Games! In the meantime we have plenty of dog lovers over on [url=https://discord.gg/tnVuDmgkb7]our Discord[/url] to chat with, so we hope to see ya there! 

-Alexandra + Sundae Month 🐾

notes.title: Visit the New Nature Park Map!
notes.content:
Hi Dog Photographers!

We are here with another update featuring the newest level, Mellowstone Park!

[previewyoutube=8k_MR5osBzg;full][/previewyoutube]

This nature park is home to lush trees, an active geyser and even a doggy mining operation!(?) First I thought we could take in the sights because my goodness, look at this beautiful sunset!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/4e4751b2388496f3075ca6e148dba5fde7292cbb.jpg[/img]

And while we are here, I wanted to show off the black and white filter for those dramatic shots. For you see, being a skilled dog photographer in all sorts of conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/c950980cb81c77dba2c6a1ca7a00f48535b31f57.jpg[/img]

You'll be able to play with all sorts of film types to compliment your pup. 

[h1]Quests[/h1]

While you're out and about you'll meet all sorts of colourful characters, including our ole pal Sea Dog who has a quest for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/8e4002fdb837c018296e1cb9df9c1fcfb6fa3d63.jpg[/img] 

These quests will get your creative juice flowing by experimenting with angles and film types. You'll also have to look high and low for different dog breeds and special dogs who only appear after certain conditions are met.

[h1]Camera Accessories[/h1]

And for all our hard work, Sea Dog has awarded us with a new camera lens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35113357/09a2fbb607ab9d1af8324940e3cf45f42f3c3547.jpg[/img]  

Customize your camera with a variety of accessories to further develop your pupfolio and advance your photography skills. 

That's all for now and I promise you'll hear from us again real soon!

-Alexandra
